**Finding: compliant** — no non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds Corio.

- **Section 2.7 (p0042)** restricts only copying/reverse engineering of the Software — standard IP protection, not a business restraint.
- **Section 13.6 (p0117)** expressly preserves each party's right to develop independently, so our freedom to build or buy competing solutions is protected.
- **"Territory" (p0024)** and **"Corio Market Segment" (p0013)** limit only the scope of the licence to Commerce One's own Software, not our business generally; Section 2.10 also obliges Commerce One not to unreasonably withhold worldwide expansion.
- **Exhibit D** sales/marketing cooperation is expressly non-binding (p0198), with no competing-product restraint; Sections 2.4 and 14.8 in fact run in our favour.

No redline proposed.
